coordinate.ankle_l_flex.limits_rad.reason: Model [-50, 20] deg (ANKLE_FLEXION_*) vs standard [-20, 50] deg: sign-flipped. Joint is about +Y with a foot link hanging down at zero pose, so the sign convention is ambiguous, and objectives disagree (squat uses +25/+35 deg, gait uses -25..-5 deg); flipping would put gait targets out of range. Needs an ankle zero-pose/sign decision.

root_joint.reason: Standard v2.0 sets bench_press.root_joint to weld (Repository_Management#2024); the bench-press generator still emits a free pelvis. Welding it at the v2.0 start via-pose root is a separate generator change.
